brief:
A new documentary titled "American Doctor" follows U.S. physicians working in Gaza's hospitals as Israel conducts military operations targeting medical facilities, Democracy Now! reported. The film examines how besieged hospitals have continued treating patients despite the conflict, with local medical staff risking their lives to provide care.

The documentary captures the conditions facing healthcare workers in Gaza during what the outlet characterizes as Israel's war on the Palestinian territory. It documents both the challenges of operating under bombardment and the commitment of medical professionals to continue their work amid widespread destruction.

title: Documentary follows U.S. doctors treating Gaza's wounded amid hospital strikes.
